en: Extra usage, prepaid balance and automatic top-up settings are informational for every account. Prism no longer requires these settings to be disabled before execution. Users manage them on the provider’s platform.

Zero allowance readings no longer reject Codex, Claude or Grok tasks locally. The service determines whether execution is available; actual quota errors still use the existing failure and relay handling. Subscription authentication, API-key isolation and manual reset-credit confirmation remain unchanged.
zh: 所有账号的额外用量、预付余额和自动充值状态均改为仅提醒，不再要求关闭后才能执行；用户在对应平台自行管理这些设置。
Codex、Claude 和 Grok 不再仅凭零额度查询结果在本地拒绝任务，能否执行以平台实际结果为准；真实额度错误仍沿用失败与接续处理。保留订阅登录校验、API Key 隔离和重置卡手动确认。
